name: VolSDF Model Architecture
aliases: Volume Rendering of Neural Implicit Surfaces
Volume Rendering of Neural Implicit Surfaces training
definition: A volume rendering framework for implicit neural surfaces that represents volume density as a transformed version of the signed distance function (SDF) to the learned surface geometry, allowing disentanglement of geometry (density) and radiance field.
summary: VolSDF is a volume rendering framework that represents density as a transformed signed distance function, disentangling geometry from radiance without requiring object masks.
